## Introduction

We are interested in adding more datasets to the Treehouse Splice Compendium prior to submitting the manuscript to a journal. Currently, the priorities are to include samples in the Treehouse polyA compendia, with healthy comparators from dGTEx.

This notebook reads sample metadata from the first release of the developmental GTEx (dGTEx) project to explore how many RNA-seq samples of what normal tissue types are represented.
The dGTEx metadata does not have file size information, so I will be unable to incorporate these files into the glacier backup costs until I obtain dbGaP access to the files.

RNA libraries from dGTEx are stranded from the metadata: "Illumina Tru-Seq Strand Specific Large Insert RNA Sequencing (75M pairs) v1 - DRAGEN"

## Setup

Files and directories

```{r files_and_directories}
## Directories ##

repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)
metadata_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "metadata")
## Files ##

# dgtex metadata with library prep and tissue type info
dgtex_metadata_file <- file.path(metadata_dir, "dGTEx_Analysis_2026-01-30_v1_Sample_Attributes_Dataset_DS_open.xlsx")
```

Read in files

```{r}
## Read in files ##
dgtex_metadata_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(dgtex_metadata_file)
```

## Summarize comparator tissue types in dGTEx v1

```{r}
dgtex_rna_summary <- dgtex_metadata_df |>
  dplyr::filter(
    ANALYTE_TYPE == "RNA:Total RNA"
  ) |>
  # select for tissue type column and sample ID column only for now
  dplyr::select(
    SAMPLE_ID,
    Tissue_type = SMTS
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    .by = Tissue_type,
    n_samples = dplyr::n()
  ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(n_samples) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_dGTEx = sum(n_samples)
  )

dgtex_rna_summary
```

The current version of dGTEx contains 342 samples, mostly represented by muscle, lung, and adipose tissue.
